title: Microscopy image panel

intent.message: Micrographs show the treatment effect across three time points at one magnification.

claims.statement: The micrographs show a progressive treatment effect across the three time points.

source_ambiguities.question: The exact exposure time for the 4 h field is unreadable at source resolution.

expected_design_characteristics: Each micrograph is one atomic image with editable overlays
Editable scale bar and time labels outside the raster pixels
Consistent brightness and contrast across the three fields
Aligned grid with equal gutters and matched field sizes
known_failure_modes: A composite image still containing multiple fields or labels
A scale bar burned into the raster pixels
Inconsistent apparent magnification from crops or zoom without a stated reason
